data.name: Basilio
data.long_meaning: From the Greek word βασιλεύς (basileus) meaning 'king' or 'royal'. Derived from the Proto-Indo-European root *bha- meaning 'to speak'. In the New Testament, Basilides was a Gnostic philosopher.

in_hebrew.name: בסיליו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: בסיליו הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו 'מלך נועז' או 'גיבור האמונה'. השם נגזר מהמילה היוונית 'בסיליוס', שפירושה 'מלך'. השם בסיליו הוא תרגום לעברית של השם היווני 'Βασιλείος', ששימש ככינוי לכוהנים ולמנהיגים נוצרים בימי קדם.

in_greek.name: Βασίλειο
in_greek.meaning: Βασιλιάς τολμηρός και ήρωας της χριστιανικής πίστης
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Βασίλειο προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'basileus', που σημαίνει 'βασιλιάς'. Στην χριστιανική παράδοση, το όνομα Βασίλειο συνδέεται με την έννοια της βασιλείας του Θεού και της πνευματικής βασιλείας του πιστού. Ο Άγιος Βασίλειος υπήρξε εξέχων Πατέρας της Εκκλησίας και Θεολόγος του 4ου αιώνα.

in_latin.name: Basilio
in_latin.meaning: Rex audax et fortis in fide christiana
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Basilio derivatur a voce graeca 'basileus', quae significat 'rex'. In traditione christiana, nomen Basilio coniungitur cum idea regni Dei et spiritualis regni fidelium. Sanctus Basilius fuit eminentissimus Ecclesiae Patrum et Theologus saeculi IV.

in_english.name: Basilio
in_english.meaning: Bold king or royal one, associated with Christian faith
in_english.long_meaning: The name Basilio originates from the Greek word 'basileus', meaning 'king'. It is associated with Saint Basil, a prominent Church Father and theologian of the 4th century. The name symbolizes spiritual royalty and courage in faith. In Christian tradition, Basilio represents a strong and noble character, embodying the virtues of leadership and devotion.

saint_reference.note: A prominent Church Father and theologian of the 4th century.

data.cultural_impact: The name Basilio carries with it an air of regalness and power. In many cultures, the title "basileus" or "basileus" (king) was a symbol of supreme authority, control, and rulership. This cultural association continues today, with names like Basilio being widely used in Spanish-speaking countries and even beyond.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Christian context, the name Basilio can be seen as reflecting the spiritual king or ruler that every believer aspires to be. The name invites us to aspire towards a deeper connection with God, striving to live a life that is regal and faithful, reflecting the divine kingship of our Creator. Additionally, in the New Testament, Basilides was a Gnostic philosopher, emphasizing the philosophical and spiritual depth within the name.

name_in_real_life.story: Mary Basilio, a minister in Dublin, Ireland, shares that their name Basilio meaning "Royal, Kingly" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.

seo.description_paragraph: The name Basilio is a Greek name with deep cultural and religious roots. Derived from the Proto-Indo-European root *bha- meaning 'to speak', Basilio is a name that signifies royalty and kingship. In the New Testament, Basilides was a renowned Gnostic philosopher, further adding to the name's rich history and significance. Though not a popular name today, the appeal of Basilio lies in its ancient origins and the sense of power and dignity it conveys.
